hero.description: I'm pursuing a Bachelor of Science in Data Science and Analytics at Kennesaw State University, with a minor in Public Health. I apply statistical analysis, machine learning, and data visualization to uncover insights, build predictive models, and solve real-world problems. My interests include healthcare analytics, predictive modeling, and developing data-driven solutions that support better decision-making.
